const.recommendation_rule: operational proposal: smallest tested pool >=90% of measured maximum synthetic throughput; not a scientific gate

const.DF_fragment_order: freeze lambda_frobenius_squared policy, tie rule and fragment hashes before prefix split
const.canonical_state_phase: largest sector amplitude real positive; freeze tie convention before source implementation

const.seed_policy: SHA256 of canonical JSON domain-separated campaign/geometry/H/DF/state/template/index/master-seed; use first 64 bits
const.canonical_distance_representation: contract-frozen decimal Angstrom string; not yet fixed

const.completion_policy: atomic write+fsync+rename; unique completed wrapper identity; completion ledger binds record digest
const.before_actual_transpile: atomic reservation of a compile invocation budget slot; reservation is not completion
const.after_actual_transpile: commit measured metrics/circuit fingerprint/invocation identity then atomically mark complete
const.uncertain_inflight_invocation: count as unresolved consumed reservation; stop for budget/identity review; no implicit retry
const.compile_cache_identity: same geometry and candidate and axis + exact numerical full-wrapper circuit fingerprint including global phase + compiler/environment/source semantics
const.different_trajectory_exact_circuit_reuse: only completed cache entries; retain separate seed/index sample records and cache owner links

const.direct_cross_environment_cost_comparison: complete identity matching established, or separately authorized new-environment anchor
const.anchor_proposal: recommended only if direct geometry comparison to historical 1.00 A is required; not needed for comparing the six new points within one new campaign

const.display_grid_definition: 0.005*(0.1/0.005)**(i/300), i=0..300; exact endpoints; insert exactly 0.05, sort and deduplicate
const.strict_eligibility: all axis allowances >0; boundary equality is ineligible
const.P_sensitivity: common P>=0; primary work plus (N_real+N_imag)*P; analytic affine envelope; retain ties
const.SE: sqrt((N_real**2*scc+N_imag**2*sss+2*N_real*N_imag*scs)/32); paired axis sample covariance, denominator n-1
const.point_pareto: eligible complete candidates only; all metrics <= and at least one <; preserve ties
